reviews.t: Great Comb but Needs a lot of Sanding
reviews.x: This is an amazing comb. The fragrance smells so good but it does fade fairly quickly. That can be solved with a few drops of essential oils. The base of the teeth of the comb is pretty rough and has taken a lot of sanding to keep it from grabbing my hair. I would have given five stars if the roughness of the teeth base was mentioned in the description.

I had no idea a comb could work like this one does. My hair is very fine, and combing it out after washing can take some time, even using spray-in conditioner/de-tangler. I can now comb it out in half the time, and with little to no pulling. (If it does pull, it's probably because I'm in a hurry.) It also feels very comfortable in my hand. I've thrown out all my other combs!
This comb is nice. I have very thick hair and this gets the job done when combing out my wet hair. Not sure this is Sandalwood, but if it is, there is no aroma to it.
I like the comb, especially during winter as it prevents static against hair. However, It has no aroma as described.

reviews.t: Quality product, wonderful for scalp and hair
reviews.x: This comb is life-changing! The brushes we choose can be the difference between major breakage and healthy hair. I guess I always thought I needed a big paddle brush to get the job done! Not the case. This brush is beautiful and takes good care of my hair. Sandalwood helps to gently smooth scalp's natural oils into hair, increasing shine without the static of ordinary plastic brushes. After I began using this comb instead of my plastic paddle brush I immediately realized how much I'd been breaki
I bought the wide tooth sandalwood comb because I wanted something that was seamless and would not catch or cut my hair, well there are cuts at the top of the teeth that do both. very dissapointed
it works really well. My long thick twirly hair appreciates it. great for equally distributing natural oils on curly hair and maintain a healthy scalp.

reviews.t: This is the best comb to use for anyone ecspecialy if you have ...
reviews.x: This is the best comb to use for anyone ecspecialy if you have thick hair! My hair is really thick and with the plastic combs I would get the static electricity, not with this comb. The smell is fine I don't really care about that, but just saw a lot of people talking about that. It just works great! I've already bought two. One for home and one for the purse!

reviews.t: the quality is degrading a lot now
reviews.x: I bought this item one year ago, I liked it very much. So I bought again this year. This is a clear quality DEGRADATION. the new comb is thinner, the teeth have clear traces of irregular distortion, making the whole piece look very bad. I am very disappointed. my words for new customers: do not buy this product any more.

reviews.t: Sturdy, good quality and lovely design.
reviews.x: I have fine, flyaway hair and after reviewing combs online bought this one on the advice of other women with similar hair type.  I can't say it works brilliantly for the frizz but I like that it's good quality and doesn't snag my hair.  It's also beautifully crafted.

Very small I was disappointed with the size of this comb. Although it is very well made it is not the same size as what you see in the picture. Good for short hair,would not be good for long thick hair.
It's sturdy and beautiful. And smells good. But the teeth is very thick. It's good for combing thick hair but not good for head massage.
Works great to gently untangle wet, long, thick hair. Does not cause any breakage of hair. Would recommend to anyone.
Beautiful, but started loosing teeth right away.

reviews.t: Truly Seamless, works well on wet and dry hair
reviews.x: WOW a comb that is truly smooth and seam-free, does not snag my long wavy hair, and smells nice.  Seems to work well on wet and dry hair.  It seems very sturdily made, but I am going to buy another just in case.  I just wish they made one with longer tins, as the heavy duty plastic one I had been using before had longer tines and it felt good going through my hair especially when wet.  But this is still a very nice product.

reviews.t: didn't work out for my long curly hair but I don't regret the purchase
reviews.x: I ordered the comb because I read I how much better wooden combs were for hair. I have curly, long hair and I have to say...I prefer my Denman brush over the wooden comb. Especially when I'm dealing with tons of knots. After I have detangled my hair and put this comb through, it's a soothing feeling on my scalp.The comb has a strong scent, and very sturdy. I don't regret the purchase.

This comb is well made and a good value.  The wood is thick and smooth and the scent is nice . It is not seamless the "teeth"  and handle are pieced together but it is not an issue this comb is sturdy.  I have curly easily knotted hair and the thing can withstand alot of pulling.  It is not a cure all for knots but it does its job without wavering.

reviews.t: Much better than plastic- great to reduce static
reviews.x: This comb is beautiful and exactly what I was searching for. I hate winter hair static and my research led me to look for wood/natural combs and brushes. I use this on my wet hair straight out of the shower. My only disappointment with this comb is that the space in between the teeth is rough and not coated at all. Perhaps it is meant to be that way...

I love this comb!  It has a gentle smell of Cedarwood. It detangles my hair easily and even absorbs the natural oil in my hair. I purchased one as a gift for my step-son who has thick wavy hair and he loves it too. This is a great comb. It doesn't break the hair, or cause static.  I would definitely purchase this comb again for myself or for a gift.

The comb works perfectly for my hair which is wavy/curly. It separates the hair just enough to take out tangles but not enough to cause frizziness. I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 because of the terrible bug spray odor that was on the comb. I washed it and it was still there. Finally I added a little essential oil to mask it and It's fine so far.

I have curly hair, sometimes wavy, and wide tooth wooden combs are so important for anyone with wavy or curly hair. The sandlewood is theraputic and an ancient healing technique. The comb naturally distributes the good oils in your hair evenly for healthy gorgeous hair! This comb feels like a head massage every time I use it. Thank you.

reviews.t: Good bye tangles and massive hair shedding.
reviews.x: I ave curly hair and it is always a struggled finding a comb that does not snag on my hair and pull out a lot of my hair. I decided to give this a try....wow and wow.  I do not now why this goes through my tangles so easily and doesn't snag on my hair but I love it. And I am so happy I found this, it is number 1 on my holy grail list.

The best ever comb ever!!!!! Best for detangling your hair.  I used to loose a lot of hair strands on a daily basis. It was even worse after a shampooing as well. But since I have stared using this comb, my hair fall has drastically reduced (probably about 1 - 4 strands). Will never go back again to plastic ones again... :)

Wonderful! I bought this to use on my beard, and since tossing the plastic combs away, I've had very few snags or snarls resulting in less hair being ripped out.. love it!  This comb builds up no static electricity either and smells wonderful when you first open it and use it. The scent does fade over time though.

reviews.t: Still works great! The wood has become "greener" over time
reviews.x: have had this for a couple of years now. Still works great! The wood has become "greener" over time, but that's expected since sandalwood tends to do that. Still smells just as pleasant as day one too. Very sturdy and eliminates static and frizz like a dream. Can't recommend wooden brushes enough.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the comb works well for detangling and managing thick, long, or curly hair, often with less pulling and breakage.
Several reviewers praise the build quality and design, describing it as sturdy, well made, and beautifully crafted.
Opinions on the sandalwood scent are mixed: some enjoy it or find it fades, while others report little to no aroma.
Some reviewers report rough or irregular teeth that snag, cut, or catch hair, requiring sanding or causing disappointment.
A few reviewers note quality or durability concerns, including teeth loosening and perceived quality degradation.
